headline: Anthropic Prepares Nasdaq Debut as IPO Pricing Finalised
summary: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic, maker of the Claude model, is preparing to price its initial public offering ahead of an expected listing on the Nasdaq exchange.
why: Anthropic is one of the world's most prominent generative AI foundation model creators. Its public valuation provides a key benchmark for private AI sector valuations.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Anthropic is completing its initial public offering to raise equity capital on Nasdaq.
